description: Purpose: rCB export-compliance checklist - PAH limits, SVHC obligations, food-contact rules and certification requirements for a given market and application. Guidelines: use for "can this rCB be sold in the EU / what PAH limits apply / what certifications do I need" questions; always state the application because the PAH limit differs (tire vs toy vs food-contact). Limits: distinguishes the REACH Annex XVII Entry 50 eight-PAH LIMIT list from the ECHA SVHC candidate-list PAH entries (notification duty) - these are different substance sets and must not be mixed; the stored limit values carry a "to be verified against EUR-Lex" note; this tool is not legal advice. Ex: check_rcb_compliance(market='EU', application='tire'), check_rcb_compliance(market='EU', application='toy').

application.description: 应用场景；决定 PAH 限值档（轮胎 ≤1 / 玩具 ≤0.5 mg/kg 等）
